scope: Offline static rigid-box point-source infinite extrusion, equal z=0, at most two interactions, 250Hz, width1. No runtime change.

methodNames.0: Generated pure routes per height sample + cached CPU common
methodNames.1: Prepared pure routes reused + cached CPU common
methodNames.2: Prepared pure and mixed routes + GPU direct/mirrors

timing: Measured component sums: packing, buffer/input setup, warm graph, receiver submission, dispatch and blocking readback, plus old CPU common costs. Large CPU common costs reused from prior measurements. Excludes first compile/warmup, Unity startup, wave references, diagnostics, audio/DSP. No GPU hardware timestamps.
limitations: Dense-scene error remains large; not a qualified DLSS teacher or live renderer.
Low-budget geometry reuse shows little benefit; small scenes do not need one million samples.
Brute-force mirror/mixed geometry enumeration still scales O(E^2 W), with O(E^2) memory.
No pilot-guided allocation, multi-frequency sample reuse, higher-order, moving, broadband, arbitrary mesh/material or finite-3D qualification.
Near-degenerate mirror endpoint margin only qualified on archived scenes/controls. Existing shader warnings remain.
